speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception.

The combination of an 8-month-old male with intermittent abdominal pain (worsening on palpation), feeding difficulties, abdominal distension, and the high suspicion of bowel obstruction confirmed by imaging findings is classic for intussusception. The "currant jelly" stools and vomiting you described further support this diagnosis of telescoping bowel. Immediate surgical consultation is required to reduce the intussusception and prevent bowel necrosis.
